summary: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd., a Cayman Islands exempt company, reported in a Form 6-K that it converted a $7,000,000 interest-free loan from CEO/Chairman Houqi Zhang into 10,000,000 newly issued Class B ordinary shares (par value $0.0005, 200 votes each). The conversion settlement is immediate upon share deposit into a DRS account; shares are subject to a three-year lock-up restricting transfer without company consent. No premium, third-party advisor, or board recommendation is mentioned. This equity-for-debt swap reduces liabilities and dilutes existing holders via voting stock. Watch for shareholder pushback or governance concerns given the CEO's dual role in setting terms.
